title: A gentle reminder
body: A small nudge at a time you choose, so there's still room for you in a busy day.
off_any_time: Turn them off whenever you like
system_prompt: Your phone will ask for permission
denied_body: HabitZen is still here for you. If you'd like reminders later, you can enable them in your phone settings.
granted_body: Your phone has allowed notifications. You can change this at any time.
quiet_body: Your phone will show notifications quietly. You can change this in settings.
unavailable_body: You can enable reminders in the Android or iPhone app. For now, keep exploring without them.
error_body: Please try again in a moment. The rest of the app will still work.
